response.sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, COUNT(*) AS track_count, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS rate FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), album_mean AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT AVG(ar.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(ar.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(ar.rate - am.mean_rate) AS average_excess FROM album_rates AS ar CROSS JOIN album_mean AS am WHERE ar.rate > am.mean_rate

assumptions.assumption: Missing Bytes are omitted from the Bytes total; all tracks still contribute to the Milliseconds total and track count. Tracks with a NULL AlbumId form one group.

alternatives.interpretation: Ignore tracks with missing Bytes when calculating both totals, but count all tracks in the album.
alternatives.sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, COUNT(*) AS track_count, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END), 0) AS rate FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), album_mean AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT AVG(ar.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(ar.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(ar.rate - am.mean_rate) AS average_excess FROM album_rates AS ar CROSS JOIN album_mean AS am WHERE ar.rate > am.mean_rate
